position_sizing.conditional_logic: Four modes: Constant (always baseLot), Linear (increment by baseLot on each loss), Martingale (multiply by lotMultiplier on loss, reset on win), Fibonacci (Fibonacci sequence on consecutive losses, reset on win). Lot is clamped to [minLot, maxLot] after calculation.

custom_logic_notes: Four-phase state machine (StandBy→Setup→Trade→Deal→StandBy). In StandBy phase, waits for time condition (Weekly: specific day+hour; Daily: specific hour; NonStop: always). At setup hour, calculates range breakout levels centered on current Ask price with High/Low boundaries. In Setup phase, monitors tick prices: if Ask>High and tradeMode=Stop→buy, if Ask>High and tradeMode=Limit→sell; if Bid<Low and tradeMode=Stop→sell, if Bid<Low and tradeMode=Limit→buy. Random tradeMode randomly picks Stop or Limit at breakout. Only one position at a time (phase-gated). On deal close (detected via OnTradeTransaction), stores result for lot progression and resets to StandBy. On loss, rangeMultiplier > 1 expands the TP range while SL stays based on original SETUP.Range. The Trade phase body is empty (EA just waits for deal to close). The Setup phase has no timeout/expiration—levels persist until price breaks out or EA is removed.
python_conversion_notes: State machine must be explicitly modeled with 4 phases. Time-based setup trigger requires session/day-of-week awareness. ATR indicator needs daily bar data (D1 ATR period 20). Martingale/Fibonacci/Linear lot progression requires persistent state tracking of last deal result and lot history. Range multiplier on losses affects TP but not SL. Random mode needs seeded RNG. OnTradeTransaction equivalent requires monitoring position closures. Margin check requires account info. The tick-level breakout detection means M1 data is insufficient for accurate backtesting—tick data is required. Phase gating ensures max 1 position, so position check is implicit. No digit adjustment is performed—SL/TP are in price units directly.
